lens: Probing & evaluation methodology (measuring whether pretraining helps: probing and downstream evaluation; evaluation protocols and standardized benchmarks)
title: Readout or Representation? A Capacity-Matched Temporal Probing and Spectral Audit of Skeleton JEPA Gait Tokens Under Source-Video-Disjoint Splits
one_sentence_question: On frozen S-JEPA gait tokens under strict source-video-grouped splits, does a capacity-matched temporal readout recover timing-sensitive gait scalars that the deployed 384-d order-invariant mean/std pooling discards by construction, and does an effective-rank/spectral audit localize that loss to the pooling operator rather than the encoder?
why_novel: Current S-JEPA gait evaluation conflates two distinct objects: the encoder's token tensor and the readout that summarizes it. The deployed readout is concat[global_mean(96), global_std(96), neuro_mean(96), neuro_std(96)] = 384-d over all 528 tokens (16 time patches x 33 joints, embed_dim 96); masked mean and std are invariant to any permutation of the token axis, so temporal order is discarded BY CONSTRUCTION. Any conclusion of the form 'the model lost temporal gait information' is therefore uninterpretable: it may describe the readout, not the representation. This paper makes that algebraic fact the lever for a controlled experiment: hold the frozen token tensor fixed (verified against the canonical embedding corpus SHA 0eff77b0 and final fingerprint d0acc262), vary only the readout under matched capacity, and measure recovery of pre-registered timing-sensitive scalars under STRICT source-video-grouped splits. Three things are novel and reusable beyond this repo: (1) a capacity-matched readout ladder in which the primary order-aware lane (global mean + signed first temporal moment m1 = sum_i tau_i z_i, tau_i centered -1..1) has the identical 384-d width and zero trainable pooling parameters as the deployed baseline, so a win cannot be attributed to a bigger head; (2) a spectral/effective-rank audit (RankMe/stable rank, per-time-patch singular spectra, adjacent-patch auto-correlation) that mechanically locates whether timing information is present-but-pooled versus absent-from-the-encoder — closing the two explicit 'never computed' gaps flagged in the audit (effective_rank, temporal_readout); and (3) a nested video-disjoint retraining ladder (frozen-transductive -> frozen-honest-readout-split -> fold-local encoder retrain) that yields the first valid generalization estimate for this small grouped skeleton dataset, where the source video — not the clip — is the independent unit and folder labels are dataset annotations, not diagnoses. Prior gait/S-JEPA biosignal work uses clip-level splits and pooled readouts; a same-token, matched-readout, source-disjoint measurement is a novel and generalizable evaluation methodology for the BrainBodyFM community.
workshop_fit: Directly hits the workshop's 'probing and downstream evaluation' and 'evaluation protocols and standardized benchmarks' bullets, and supports 'measuring whether pretraining helps'. It is squarely on the motor side of the loop the 2026 edition emphasizes (pose-extracted gait from video as a behavioral biosignal), and it delivers a transferable evaluation lesson for self-supervised biosignal representations: representation quality is only defined relative to a response operator, and honest source-level splits are mandatory for small grouped skeleton datasets. The methodological contribution (matched-readout diagnostic + spectral localization + retraining ladder) is non-archival-friendly and reusable as a checklist by other motion/sensorimotor foundation-model papers.

decisive_experiments.question: Can we extract frozen target-encoder tokens and prove the deployed readout is order-invariant while the moment readout is order-sensitive?
decisive_experiments.protocol: Load final checkpoint (file SHA 6e67fc5c, fingerprint d0acc262) with the self-contained SkeletonPatchEncoder/SJEPAGait classes; extract per-sequence token tensors [16,33,96] for all 159 sequences; reproduce the 384-d Lane A pooling and verify its embedding-corpus SHA equals 0eff77b0 (same-token lineage). Then permute the 16-dim time axis post-encoding: Lane A (mean/std) must be numerically identical to FP tolerance; Lane B (mean + signed temporal moment) must change.
decisive_experiments.expected: Exact reproduction; Lane A invariant, Lane B varies.
decisive_experiments.interpretation: Proves the comparison manipulates only the intended information channel; any later win is attributable to order, not to a changed token pipeline.

decisive_experiments.question: Does a capacity-matched temporal readout recover timing-sensitive gait scalars that mean/std pooling loses, on the SAME frozen tokens?
decisive_experiments.protocol: Readout ladder from one tensor: A = deployed 384-d order-invariant mean/std; B = global mean + signed first temporal moment (384-d, 0 trainable pooling params); C = segment-level mean/std over 4 coarse normalized-time bins; D = per-time-patch (joint-averaged 16x96) pooling fed to a small attention/1D-conv/LSTM temporal head with output projected to <=384 and total trainable params matched to the ridge probe within 5%. All feed ridge regression, alpha tuned inside training sources only. Targets (pre-registered, deterministic, normalized-time-only): (1) normalized time of peak left-right ankle separation; (2) signed left-right ankle phase lag; (3) early-vs-late lower-limb motion-energy difference. Strict GroupKFold by source video, enumerating every feasible holdout (1 canonical normal, 2 Parkinson's, 2 CP videos => at most 2 stratified folds; leave-one-video-out for singletons). Report per-source normalized MAE and R2 before any pooled summary.
decisive_experiments.runtime: hours (frozen; vectorized readouts, ridge sweep seconds per fold)
decisive_experiments.expected: B reduces mean normalized MAE >=10% vs A with sign-consistent improvement on >=75% of held-out sources; C and D confirm the effect is order-sensitivity, not the specific moment formula.
decisive_experiments.interpretation: A win means timing information survives in tokens and pooling was the bottleneck; a null (B ~ A) while raw kinematics still solve the targets means the encoder never encoded time (feeds motion-target retrain, proposal 04).

decisive_experiments.question: Is the recovered timing signal genuine gait structure, not extraction provenance, source identity, or detector missingness?
decisive_experiments.protocol: Three control lanes on the same source-grouped folds: (a) raw-kinematic hand-crafted timing features computed directly from cached coordinates/validity masks (non-neural, fixed); (b) missingness-only 97-feature visibility signature (already measured at 0.448 acc all-96, 0.333 exp5); (c) nuisance probes predicting extraction provenance (canonical vs added-normal path), source-video identity, and mean landmark coverage from each readout's output.
decisive_experiments.expected: Raw-kinematic features hit a high ceiling (confirms targets are real in pose, mirroring the laterality probe where raw coords hit R2~0.9999 vs learned R2=-0.187); missingness sits at its known floor; improvement on timing targets is NOT accompanied by >0.02 balanced-accuracy rise on provenance/source nuisances.
decisive_experiments.interpretation: Separates 'gait structure recovered' from 'shortcut recovered'; the known canonical-vs-added-normal provenance confound (63/75 normal rows from the added path) is the key falsifier.

decisive_experiments.question: Where does temporal information live or die — in the token tensor or in the pooling operator?
decisive_experiments.protocol: Compute RankMe/stable rank and the singular-value spectrum (top-k spectral mass) of: (a) per-sequence 528x96 token tensor; (b) per-time-patch 33x96 slices; (c) the corpus-level 384-d pooled matrix. Add adjacent-time-patch cosine auto-correlation of token centroids and a per-patch-vs-global spectral alignment measure.
decisive_experiments.expected: If adjacent-patch auto-correlation exceeds a shuffled-patch null AND per-patch ranks are high while the pooled matrix rank collapses, the loss is localized to pooling; if the token tensor is already near rank-deficient along time, the encoder never encoded temporal structure.
decisive_experiments.interpretation: Closes the audit's 'effective_rank never computed' gap and turns any E1 null into a mechanistic, publishable finding rather than a failed run.

decisive_experiments.question: How much of the timing claim survives moving from transductive readout to an honest (still-frozen) source-grouped readout split?
decisive_experiments.protocol: Reproduce the labeled transductive reference numbers (all-96 0.724 acc / 0.750 macroF1; video-disjoint 2-fold 0.564/0.495; pooled 0.566/0.496) as Level 0. Then rerun the SAME Lane A-vs-B comparison under strict source-video-grouped splits with the frozen checkpoint as Level 1, and report the transductive-vs-honest gap on the three timing targets (not only on classification accuracy).
decisive_experiments.expected: A measurable gap between transductive and honest-readout-split estimates on timing targets, quantified per source.
decisive_experiments.interpretation: Demonstrates the evaluation-repair contribution (encoder exposure) even before retraining; the gap itself is a headline result for the workshop's evaluation-protocols theme.

decisive_experiments.question: Does the temporal-readout advantage survive when the encoder is retrained with held-out source videos excluded?
decisive_experiments.protocol: Nested video-disjoint retraining: assign source videos to folds before preprocessing/encoder training; retrain the encoder per fold (Stage 0 normal-only as the cheapest rung, and the full 5-stage curriculum as the complete rung) excluding held-out sources, then rerun Lane A vs B/C/D on fold-local frozen tokens. Full 600-epoch curriculum ~20 min/fold, single stage a few minutes; run 2-5 folds (plus 3 screening seeds) within the window.
decisive_experiments.runtime: ~20-40 min/fold; 2-5 folds = hours to half a day (partial is acceptable)
decisive_experiments.expected: The only valid generalization estimate; compare against Level 1 to measure encoder-exposure leakage on timing targets specifically.
decisive_experiments.interpretation: If the effect persists under retraining, the temporal-readout claim generalizes; if it degrades, the paper reports exactly where the ladder rung fails — itself a novel, honest finding for small grouped skeleton datasets.

decisive_experiments.question: Is any readout win a genuine order-sensitivity effect rather than a bigger-head artifact?
decisive_experiments.protocol: Repeat E1 with (a) a small 1D-conv/attention temporal head whose trainable parameters match the ridge probe (~384) within 5%, and (b) an intentionally larger head (few-thousand params) as the capacity upper bound.
decisive_experiments.runtime: hours (frozen; small head training is seconds-to-minutes per fold)
decisive_experiments.expected: The zero-parameter Lane B (primary claim) and the parameter-matched head both improve; if only the large head wins, the result is downgraded to a capacity effect.
decisive_experiments.interpretation: Neutralizes the top reviewer risk flagged in the plan ('a larger temporal head would be an unfair comparison').

decisive_experiments.question: Is the primary result stable to target noise, gap removal, and seed variation, and not carried by one source?
decisive_experiments.protocol: Target reliability under small coordinate noise and short-gap removal; 3 screening seeds then 5 frozen confirmation seeds after targets/penalties are frozen; per-source sign consistency (>=75% of held-out sources must agree); report all source dots before pooling.
decisive_experiments.runtime: hours (frozen; seed sweeps are embarrassingly parallel)
decisive_experiments.expected: Stable sign, no single-source dominance; acceptable degradation under noise.
decisive_experiments.interpretation: Bounds the claim within what 1/2/2 canonical source counts can support; prevents overclaiming clinical or population validity.

effort_and_feasibility: Highly feasible in 3 days because nearly everything reuses frozen assets. Day 1: extract token tensors and reproduce the canonical 0eff77b0 embedding corpus (E0), run the Lane A/B moment readout and the segment/attention heads under source-grouped folds (E1), and run all controls (E2) plus the spectral/effective-rank audit (E3) — all frozen, collectively a few hours, mostly CPU. Day 2: quantify the transductive-vs-honest gap (E4) and start the video-disjoint retraining ladder (E5): full 600-epoch curriculum is ~20 min/fold, single-stage a few minutes, so 2-5 folds plus a screening seed set fit in under half a day. Day 3: the capacity-matched head adversarial (E6), seed confirmation and per-source sensitivity (E7), then package. The critical path is fold-local token extraction and SHA verification of the same-token lineage, both already supported by the reusable classes (SkeletonPatchEncoder, SJEPAGait, prepare_sequence, masked_mean_std, pooled_embeddings) and by plan/_shared/evaluation-contract.md. A complete Level-2 multi-seed retraining may not fully finish; the paper is structured so Level 0-1 (frozen, fully runnable in hours) is the primary frozen-encoder result and Level 2 is presented as the generalization ladder, with even a partial rung (Stage-0-only folds) publishable. Total realistic effort: 1.5-2.5 researcher-days.
main_risks: Temporal information may not survive in the token tensor at all (encoder objective is position-prediction not motion; 64-frame resize plus normalized time only): Lane B ~ Lane A. Mitigation: the spectral audit (E3) and raw-kinematic ceiling (E2) convert this into a mechanistic 'the encoder never encoded time' finding that motivates the motion-target retrain (proposal 04) — a publishable informative null, not a failure.

Provenance/source confound dominates: 63/75 normal rows come from the added-normal extraction path while all abnormal rows come from the canonical path, and missingness-only already hits 0.448 acc. A temporal readout that wins only by decoding provenance or source identity fails the claim; E2's nuisance probes are the gate.

Tiny source counts (1 canonical normal, 2 Parkinson's, 2 CP videos) permit at most 2 stratified group folds and no unbiased CV variance; a result can flip across feasible holdouts. Mitigation: enumerate every feasible holdout, report per-source dots, require sign-consistency, and never present seed spread as source uncertainty.

Capacity-matching critique: a learned temporal head is not literally 'the same' as a fixed moment. Mitigation: the primary claim rests on the zero-parameter 384-d moment readout (Lane B) against the zero-parameter 384-d mean/std (Lane A), with the parameter-matched head (E6) as the adversarial bound.

Single training run/seed in the frozen checkpoint lineage and normal-anchor drift (0.954->0.594) complicate causal claims about the encoder; mitigation: pin all reporting to the fresh 0eff77b0 lineage (never mix with the historical ed20c430 set) and let E5's retraining ladder carry the generalization burden.

No cadence/seconds/clinical claims are permitted from 64-frame normalized-time clips; folder labels are dataset annotations, not diagnoses. The targets are framed strictly as representation diagnostics, pre-registered before any readout performance is seen.
paper_outline_5p:
Page 1 — Title/abstract; Introduction: state the exact algebraic fact (concat[global_mean, global_std, neuro_mean, neuro_std] over 528 tokens is permutation-invariant, so temporal order is discarded by construction); the conflated conclusion in current S-JEPA gait evaluation; the falsifiable question (does a capacity-matched temporal readout recover timing scalars that pooling loses, and where does the information live/die?).

Page 2 — Method: token lineage and SHA-verified same-token extraction (0eff77b0 / d0acc262); the readout ladder (A mean/std 384, B mean + signed first temporal moment 384, C segment-level mean/std, D per-time-patch attention/conv/LSTM head, capacity-matched); the three pre-registered normalized-time targets; the strict source-video-grouped protocol (GroupKFold, alpha tuned in-train, per-source reporting); the control set (raw-kinematic, missingness-only, provenance/source nuisance); the spectral/effective-rank audit (RankMe, per-patch spectra, adjacent-patch auto-correlation); the nested retraining ladder (frozen-transductive -> frozen-honest -> fold-local retrain).

Page 3 — Results I (frozen, hours): the same-token readout sweep and the primary Lane A-vs-B comparison on the three targets (per-source dot plots + pooled normalized MAE/R2); controls (raw-kinematic ceiling, missingness floor, nuisance deltas); the spectral audit figure localizing information loss to pooling vs encoder.

Page 4 — Results II (generalization ladder): transductive-vs-honest-readout-split gap (E4); fold-local video-disjoint retraining results (E5, even if partial); capacity-matched head adversarial (E6); robustness/seed sensitivity (E7).

Page 5 — Discussion: readout-vs-representation interpretation; limits (source counts, provenance confound, normalized time, single lineage); a reusable 6-point evaluation checklist for small grouped skeleton/biosignal datasets; conclusion. References excluded per 5-page limit.
recommendation: Pursue this as the single primary direction. It is the highest-expected-value paper available in 3 days because the motivating fact is exact rather than speculative (a mean and std do not change under token permutation), the decisive experiment is a same-token, capacity-matched readout sweep that runs in hours on frozen checkpoints, and both outcomes are publishable: a positive result shows pooling — not the encoder — was discarding recoverable timing information (a clean, generalizable evaluation lesson for the workshop's probing/evaluation theme), while a null is mechanistically localized by the spectral audit into 'the encoder never encoded time', which directly motivates the motion-target retrain as the next rung. Execution order: (1) E0 token lineage + permutation sanity, (2) E1 Lane A-vs-B sweep + E2 controls + E3 spectral audit, all frozen on Day 1; (3) E4 transductive-vs-honest gap and launch E5 retraining ladder on Day 2; (4) E6 capacity head + E7 seed/source sensitivity and packaging on Day 3. Ship Level 0-1 (frozen) as the primary result and present Level 2 retraining as the generalization ladder even if only partially complete; every claim must enumerate feasible source holdouts, report per-source before pooling, carry the missingness/provenance controls, and never convert folder labels into diagnostic claims. Guardrail: if E1's Lane B does not beat Lane A by the pre-registered 10% margin with >=75% source-sign consistency and E2's nuisance delta stays <=0.02 balanced accuracy, pivot the narrative to the informative-null + spectral-localization story and do not inflate the readout head.
